line.en: the first rooster day of the tori-no-ichi. the shrine and the temple next door are open all day, and the stalls sell the rake charms for good business luck.
line.de: der erste hahnentag des tori-no-ichi. schrein und nachbartempel sind den ganzen tag geöffnet, die stände verkaufen die rechen-glücksbringer für gutes geschäft.
line.tr: tori-no-ichi'nin ilk horoz günü. tapınak ve yandaki tapınak bütün gün açık; standlar iyi iş için tırmık biçimli şans nesnelerini satıyor.

sparks.why: First rooster day (ichi-no-tori) of the 2026 tori-no-ichi on sat 7.11, open all day per matcha-jp and Exoticca's Tokyo November guide.

title.en: oedo antique market, tokyo international forum.
title.tr: oedo antika pazarı, tokyo international forum'da.

line.en: the oedo antique market on saturday 7 november, a short walk from yurakucho station. old prints, glassware and small things to dig through.
line.de: der oedo-antikmarkt am samstag 7. november, wenige schritte vom bahnhof yurakucho. alte drucke, glaswaren und kleine dinge zum durchstöbern.
line.tr: 7 kasım cumartesi oedo antika pazarı, yurakucho istasyonundan kısa bir yürüme mesafesinde. eski baskılar, cam eşyalar ve küçük şeyler.

sparks.why: Oedo Antique Market listed for sat 7.11 on the tokyocheapo.com event calendar, held at Tokyo International Forum.
